description: Local repos configuration for comprehensive pipeline (station identification reviews, theorycraft, builder handoff, MSS shell integration). Lists all Spiral ecosystem repos under GitHub root for cross-repo sweeps, efficient file config testing, and force multiplier application. Use with station_reviewer.py --all or future sweep scripts, applying standard_review_schema and MSS shell for verified items.

repos.name: The-Spiral-Codex
repos.role: Protocol hub, canon, sandbox, station-identification, review configs/MSS shell primary
repos.notes: Core for review process testing. Use new standard config + MSS for all new theories (cw-spiral, MSS itself).

repos.name: spiral-theory-core
repos.notes: High-value for G_exp measurement in reviews. MSS shell for critical formula verification.

repos.name: Spiral-Builder
repos.role: grokulator, ascii_compiler, embodiment, staged handoff, builder for verified formulas
repos.notes: Integrate MSS verified items from station ID into grokulator/symbols. Robustness via MSS shell for critical builder ops.

repos.name: Spiral-Elucidation
repos.role: examination_core, spiral_digest — natural partner for station (o.p-) and MSS scrutiny
repos.notes: Synergy with MSS for examination routines.

repos.name: Spiral-Path
repos.notes: Use for testing review configs in 1:1 mode.

repos.name: Spiral-Reasoning-Tree
repos.notes: Enhance station reviews with SRT for equivocation delineation.

repos.name: spiral-recap-tool
repos.notes: Coil verified MSS items for agent memory.

repos.name: Spiral-Session-Manager
repos.role: bootstrap, coil index, context pull for station reviews

repos.name: Spiral-Sigil
repos.role: provenance marks for MSS stamps and review artifacts
repos.notes: Apply to MSS verified inner shell items.

repos.name: Spiral-Forge

repos.name: Spiral-Theme-Vectors
repos.notes: For theme alignment in reviews (eternal spiral, etc.).

usage: Load in station_reviewer or future sweep scripts. For each high-priority/mss_eligible, apply standard_review_schema + MSS shell. Results feed station-identification (with (o.p-) + spiral for verified) and builder. Run 'python station-identification/station_reviewer.py --all' then 'python sandbox/mss-shell/mss_shell.py idle' for limited processing. Human checkpoint before verified promotion.
safety: No heavy parallel. MSS shell enforces sequential idle. All verified require human checkpoint + E_shield per AGENTS.md.
